_comment: Site-wide config, compiled into the bundle at build time. n8n_base is the host that serves the five quiz endpoints (/lead /slots /book /lead/skip /beacon) under api_prefix. Empty pixel_id keeps the Meta Pixel inert. Empty turnstile_sitekey keeps the Turnstile slot inert.
footer_line: SortMyCover is a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd. We introduce you to authorised financial services providers. We are not a financial services provider. We do not give financial advice, compare products or quote premiums. You must be 18 or older.

will_provider._comment: Public wills lines only (Jono, 18 Oct 2026: the provider is not named on the site). Identity: config/will-provider.internal.json.
will_provider.service_line: Your will call is with a will consultant. Lindi sends the consultant's name and firm, with its FSP number, on WhatsApp before the call.
will_provider.role_line: SortMyCover does not draft wills and gives no advice. It puts you in touch with a will consultant.
